'''K'derek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarong]]. Along with his sister, [[Sk'rirak]], K'derek worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as [[Spy/Legends|information gatherers]]. K'derek was not as cheerful as other Tarongs due to witnessing acts of [[Torture/Legends|torture]], interrogations and murder while spying on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. Vowing to oppose the Empire, K'derek became an expert with explosives.<ref name="GG12" />
